about: Round 66: another tenant's set customization of one policySetId seen by decisions in both tenants. A read of the v3 export by a tenant copies the other tenant's customized set and moves its stored policies and child sets into the reader's set of that id, or answers 500 when the reader holds none. Each case writes in a second tenant from steps and deletes what it wrote in both.

cases.about: Control: an ACTIVE set uploaded in a tenant of its own, decided and read back.

Another tenant uploads a set whose policy allows UPDATE and whose child set allows LIST, and customizes it at CUSTOMER to allow READ, before this tenant holds the set, so this tenant's first read answers 500. This tenant uploads the same policySetId with a policy of its own allowing DELETE. Decisions in both tenants after every step, each followed by that tenant's raw reads of the export: whether a read moves the other tenant's policy and child set into this tenant's set, what the 500 leaves, and what each side's delete leaves.

Another tenant uploads a set whose policy allows UPDATE and whose child set allows LIST, and customizes it at PROJECT to allow READ, before this tenant holds the set, so this tenant's first read answers 500. This tenant uploads the same policySetId with a policy of its own allowing DELETE. Decisions in both tenants after every step, each followed by that tenant's raw reads of the export: whether a read moves the other tenant's policy and child set into this tenant's set, what the 500 leaves, and what each side's delete leaves.

Another tenant uploads a set whose policy allows UPDATE and whose child set allows LIST, and customizes it at CUSTOMER to allow READ, after this tenant's first write of the same set. This tenant uploads the same policySetId with a policy of its own allowing DELETE. Decisions in both tenants after every step, each followed by that tenant's raw reads of the export: whether a read moves the other tenant's policy and child set into this tenant's set, what the 500 leaves, and what each side's delete leaves.

Sets without child sets. A read by this tenant moves another tenant's customized policy into this tenant's set; the other tenant deletes its customization, this tenant customizes the set at CUSTOMER, and the other tenant reads the export: the moved policy moves back into its own tenant's set, or stays.
Another tenant customizes one set at PROJECT and at CUSTOMER; this tenant holds the set and reads the export: whether the copies of both levels take over the same policy, and where it decides.
